content_blocks.label: clause_1._NOTICE_TO_QUIT
content_blocks.text: You are hereby notified that you must vacate the premises at 456 Elm Street, Sunset City, State of Novacore, by 11:59 p.m. on October 15, 2024.

content_blocks.label: clause_2.1_CAUSE_FOR_EVICTION
content_blocks.text: The reason for this notice is your failure to comply with the terms of your lease agreement, specifically the obligation to maintain the premises in good repair and condition.

content_blocks.label: clause_3._REMEDY
content_blocks.text: If you fail to vacate the premises as required, further action may be taken to enforce this Notice.
